patch_description: Rather than adding a separate slope-stabilizer stage (which Gen 8 showed degrades performance by adding lag and stacked complexity), this edit embeds a lightweight deadband directly into the fused velocity computation. The forward (vel_f) and backward (vel_b) velocity estimates are summed, and if the magnitude of the fused velocity falls below a small threshold (≈ 0.2 × std of the first difference of the input), the velocity is zeroed out (deadband) and the fused level is held flat. This suppresses spurious slope reversals caused by noise without introducing pipeline latency, directly targeting the false-reversal penalty while preserving responsiveness for genuine large-magnitude trend changes.
